answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit. What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wharf.
